lines.text: Welcome, confident speakers! Today you will learn to introduce yourself in a clear, friendly way.
Every good introduction starts with a greeting.
Say good morning before twelve noon, and good afternoon after lunch.
You can also say hello everyone, or hi.
Say your first name, your class and one or two things you like.
For example, my name is Kabir and I am in Class 4.
Keep your surname, address and phone number private.
Do not just say what you like.
Say why you like it with the word because.
I love cricket because it is exciting.
Please, thank you, sorry and excuse me make people happy to talk to you.
When you meet someone new, say nice to meet you.
They will say nice to meet you too.
First greet everyone.
Then say your name, your class and two likes with because.
Finally, say thank you for listening.
Listen to Aarav. Good morning, everyone! My name is Aarav, and I am in Class 4.
I love cricket because it is exciting. My favourite food is dosa because it is crispy.
Thank you for listening! Did you notice how he started and how he finished?
He began with a greeting and ended with thank you. That makes a talk sound complete.
Now listen to two friends meeting for the first time.
Meera says, Hi! I am Meera. What is your name?
Kabir answers, Hello, Meera. I am Kabir. Nice to meet you.
Meera replies, Nice to meet you too! Which class are you in?
See how they take turns? One person speaks, then asks a question back.
Here are four star tips for every time you speak.
Sit up tall, look up at the camera, and smile when you say hello.
Speak slowly and loudly enough, so even the person at the back can hear you.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
